text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
There's something I wanna do for you,
Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Your nails!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wha... What?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! The manager here is chill. They
said as long the nail polish
doesn't smell
too strong, they don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, like, what color should we do? This
pink is fire!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I do like pink,
but... Um... What's this all
about?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Well, 'cuz like...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You've lowkey been looking kinda sad
lately, but like, I'm not that good with
words and stuff, so... I didn't wanna hurt
your feelings or
anything.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean,
I suck at this kinda thing. I don't
know how to cheer people
up, especially
chill, quiet girls like you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I tried to comfort my classmate once and I
flopped. She said she
wasn't "feeling up
for fun right now."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Then someone else went to comfort her
and she felt better right
away. I felt kinda
useless, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But, like... I'm just like everyone else—I
want my friends to feel better
too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Jordan...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
We're all different,
right? So it's okay if we
all show our feelings in
different ways. I
thought I'd try the best way I know how!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And that's with a lit manicure! Here, give
me your hands!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you! I didn't realize you were
thinking about me!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry I didn't notice.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nah, don't be silly!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I know I'm pretty stupid, but that
doesn't make me useless,
y'know? And
you're small,
but you're not useless either.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
We're all unique,
and that's a good thing. I
bet there's stuff only you
can do too!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well... if you need anything,
I've got
your back, bestie. So just
hit me up.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Well, in that case... Can I ask you
something? It's...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: For real?! That sounds dope!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: R-really? I'll give it a try then!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Nom, nom... Gulp. Ah, there's nothing better than hotpot in the winter! Huh? Bourbon?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O, Flash, apologies for bothering
you during your lunch
break. Flash, I have
a request for you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'd like your feedback on this recipe I
created. My objective is to
make the best
chocolates possible to give to friends.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh, that looks mouthwatering!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, those chocolate macarons do look
delicious. Hmm, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The key to making good macarons is
folding the batter. It's important
to
incorporate just the right amount of air
into it. And then...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see. I will save this to my memory logs.
